routes: POST /api/rating retains its canonical route; no route or response shape change.
apiContracts: Rating writes accept only positive safe-integer novel IDs and whole-number ratings from 1 through 10.
Fractional, non-finite, string-typed, missing, null, out-of-range and unsafe integer inputs are rejected with HTTP 400.
The server does not round or coerce a fractional rating into an accepted value.
dataEntities: ratings; existing canonical table and 1–10 range are reused; no schema change.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Reuse the existing ratings table and its 1–10 CHECK constraint. No migration is required.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: No stored data or schema changes. Existing valid integer ratings remain accepted.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert the route-only validation simplification if an unexpected API regression appears; no data repair is required.

privacySecurity.authorization: Only the authenticated user can write their own rating.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: Rating writes continue to bind user_id to authenticated session user.
privacySecurity.csrf: Existing write-route CSRF protections remain unchanged.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Existing request body and route limits remain unchanged.
privacySecurity.referentialIntegrity: Existing novel publication and rights-eligibility checks remain unchanged.

changeSummary: Removes redundant Math.round from rating input handling after explicit safe-integer validation, making the 1–10 whole-number contract direct and regression-tested.

No rounding or fractional coercion occurs.
Published and rights-eligible novel checks remain unchanged.
